findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for these nodes.

Continuous contrast features are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed; several landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts across the window, so a constant rule is not supported for those features.

First-rate and last-rate z values for the same landmark features have opposite signs (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass, landmark_00_local_dx, landmark_00_local_dy, landmark_00_local_cxx, landmark_00_local_cyy), indicating time-conditioned rather than constant contrast behavior within the observed support.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast attention at observed score nodes
hypotheses.falsifier: A constant contrast rule matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule on held-out observed-node fit fidelity without added sign conflicts.
hypotheses.observable: landmark contrast features at observed score times
hypotheses.scope: observed window [0.0,0.5], predicted endpoint world coordinates
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule over the observed window would track the sign-changing landmark contrast features better than a constant rule, without extrapolation beyond [0.0,0.5].

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Continuous contrast curves are coordinate descriptors, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies.
No current study outcome data are available to this role, so no causal selection or neural-module claim is made.
